title: RoomieVault v1.6 - In-App Updates & Mutual Roommate Sync
description:
• In-App APK Download with real-time percentage progress bar
• One-click direct in-app package installer (no need to open browser)
• Permanent unified signing key to prevent package conflicts
• Mutual Roommate Visibility: Roommates added by flatmates automatically appear on both accounts
• Automatic cloud household assignment and bidirectional sync
